content.text: Billing rounds the combined byte total, while uploads round each file separately. Deletion rounds down and only searches the first page of active issues; recounting also omits workspace filtering. I’ll use the running counter for billing checks, recount each workspace’s files with per-file rounding, and look up attachments directly by workspace and ID.
